verdict.rationale: The GitHub README explicitly lists 'Undetected Browser Support: Bypass sophisticated bot detection systems' (crawl4ai-gh-9). This is backed by documented stealth modes (crawl4ai-docs-6), a managed-browser option for avoiding bot detection (crawl4ai-gh-16), and proxy-chain retry (crawl4ai-gh-4). The evidence is only feature-list claims, with no configuration detail or proof that it works. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how to enable and configure undetected mode, independent or hands-on corroboration of bypass success against real anti-bot systems.
